One way the team tries to reach an Initiative's outcome: an output that gets tested, built, kept or dropped. It can be a digital solution, content, a process change or training. An Initiative may try several.

- **Definition:** [Glossary: Solution, Digital solution](/system/glossary)
- **How it works:** [09 Initiatives and solutions](/system/initiatives-and-solutions)
- **Owner:** product manager decides; product owner helps scope
- **Links to:** Parent: [Initiative](/templates/initiative). Children: [Deliverable](/templates/deliverable)

## Template

| Field | What goes here |
| --- | --- |
| Solution | Short descriptive name |
| Initiative | The parent Initiative |
| What it is | [Solution] will enable [user group] to [do something], which we expect to move [the Initiative's outcome]. |
| Riskiest assumptions | What must be true for it to work: desirable, viable, feasible, usable |
| How we'll test it | The cheapest test that would tell us to stop |
| Size | T-shirt size (XS, S, M, L, XL) |
| Planned slices | The Deliverables, by quarter, once it survives testing |
| Status | Exploring, testing, building, live, on hold or dropped, with the result. On hold: say why, and what would restart it |

A discovery decision sets the status:

| Discovery decision | Solution status |
|---|---|
| Build it | Building |
| Don't build it | Dropped |
| Try something different | Back to exploring, or on hold |

## DMV example

**Solution B: License Ready Check**

| Field | Entry |
| --- | --- |
| Solution | License Ready Check |
| Initiative | Single-trip new driver licenses |
| What it is | License Ready Check will enable first-time applicants to confirm before their visit that their documents will be accepted, which we expect to move the repeat-trip rate. |
| Riskiest assumptions | Viable: most repeat trips come from document problems (A1). Desirable: applicants will send photos before a visit (A2). Feasible: identity verification can take pre-visit uploads (A4). |
| How we'll test it | Concierge test: staff review emailed photos for 25 applicants before building anything. |
| Size | XL (5+ sprints), sliced across three quarters |
| Planned slices | Q3: photo upload and staff review for the two most common documents (Now). Q4: all standard documents. Q1: a name-mismatch flag linked to booking. |
| Status | Building. The concierge test held: 19 of 25 sent photos, and 7 problems were caught before a visit. |

The same Initiative dropped Solution A (a document checklist) after prototype testing and is holding Solution C (a real-time eligibility check) for later.
